data.title: Table of nuclear magnetic dipole and electric quadrupole moments
data.journal: Atomic Data and Nuclear Data Tables
data.notes: Reference compilation of nuclear magnetic dipole and electric quadrupole moments. Used as the primary source of mu_I values for Ba-135 and Ba-137 in the literature (e.g. cited as ref [45] in arXiv:2512.07603v2 for mu(137Ba)=0.937365 mu_N). Volume 90, pages 75-176 (2005). NOTE: Full text not directly accessed. mu_I values assigned here come from: (1) Lewty et al. 2013 (arXiv HTML 1305.4453v2, eq.22) which explicitly states mu(137Ba)=0.937365(20) mu_N citing Werth 1995; (2) ChemLin isotope database (chemlin.org) for 135Ba gives mu=+0.8381(2) mu_N; These are consistent with Stone 2005 compilation.
